name: Edsken Bessemer steel
summary: At Edsken in Sweden, Göran Fredrik Göransson made the Bessemer air-blowing method work at practical scale in 1858, producing satisfactory steel ingots and converting his works to it.
description: Göran Fredrik Göransson applied the Bessemer method on a practical scale and obtained satisfactory steel ingots.
